comment: The crew. Carried over from the parked project's manager roster — Ben's copy, and the best character-per-word in the whole project. Quirks are flavour only: they never modify the economy, so the sim stays honest and nobody has to balance a joke. A new crew is rolled each run, which is its own small pleasure after a sale.

staff.name: Archie T.
staff.quirk: Builds the roster three weeks out. Nobody knows how. Nobody asks.

staff.name: Kimberley R.
staff.quirk: Has never once run out of brioche. Suppliers fear her.

staff.name: Deano
staff.quirk: Gun on the grill. Availability described as spiritual.

staff.name: Soph M.
staff.quirk: Replies to every review within the hour, including the unhinged ones.

staff.name: Trung N.
staff.quirk: Runs the pass like air traffic control. Headset optional but preferred.

staff.name: Bec W.
staff.quirk: Slow. Reliable. Has closed every Sunday for four years without comment.

staff.name: Jonno
staff.quirk: Over-orders buns every single week. Also never 86'd a burger during a rush.

staff.name: Priya K.
staff.quirk: Keeps a spreadsheet of which regulars order what. It is 40 tabs deep.

staff.name: Macca
staff.quirk: 17 years in hospo. Moves at one speed. It is the correct speed.

staff.name: Ellie F.
staff.quirk: Invented three specials that went on the permanent menu. Takes full credit. Fair enough.

staff.name: Hass
staff.quirk: Can smell a health inspector from the car park.

staff.name: Georgia P.
staff.quirk: Trains every new starter the same way: quietly, properly, once.

staff.name: Vinnie
staff.quirk: Negotiates with the delivery drivers like it's a hostage situation.

staff.name: Tash L.
staff.quirk: The fryer section has never once beaten her. The fryer section has tried.

staff.name: Robbo
staff.quirk: Cheapest hire on the board. You get exactly what you pay for, on time, every time.

staff.name: Chen W.
staff.quirk: Does the stocktake to two decimal places. Found the till discrepancy from 2024.

staff.name: Freya D.
staff.quirk: Doubles output during a rush. Requires a debrief afterwards.

staff.name: Sammy O.
staff.quirk: Knows every regular's order and exactly one fact about their dog.

staff.name: Kez
staff.quirk: Locks up, sets the alarm, texts 'done'. Has never elaborated.

staff.name: Dougie B.
staff.quirk: Once catered a wedding out of the delivery window during a Friday service. Never again. Probably.

regularsComment: Names for the customers who keep coming back. Ordinary on purpose — a regular is not a character, they're a face you know.
